title: Grêmio's standing in the free-kick goals ranking
seoTitle: Grêmio's Standing in the Free-Kick Goal Ranking
subtitle: Jean Pyerre leads the team with three conversions in ten years
excerpt: Jean Pyerre is Grêmio's main free-kick taker, with three goals in the last ten years. The club ranks second in the Série A free-kick goals ranking.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Jean Pyerre is Grêmio's main free-kick taker, with three goals in the last ten years. The club ranks second in the Série A free-kick goals ranking, behind only Atlético-MG.

Grêmio's standing in the free-kick goals ranking

In the survey conducted by Gato Mestre, published on GE on December 7, 2025, Grêmio appears in second place with 16 free-kick goals, behind only Atlético-MG, which scored 24.

Jean Pyerre's contribution

Jean Pyerre leads Grêmio's list of takers with three free-kick goals. He shares the same number of free-kick goals as Raphael Veiga, who plays for Palmeiras.

other Grêmio scorers

  • Edilson – 2 goals
  • Luan – 2 goals
  • Diego Souza – 2 goals
  • Fernandinho – 1 goal
  • Maicon – 1 goal
  • Alisson – 1 goal
  • Vanderson – 1 goal
  • Suárez – 1 goal
  • Pavón – 1 goal
  • Jovane Cabral – 1 goal

comparison with Atlético-MG

Atlético-MG leads the ranking with 24 free-kick goals, with Hulk being the top individual scorer with 12 goals. The club's second and third-placed players, Otero and Gustavo Scarpa, have six goals each.

impact on club performance

Free-kick goals have been an important weapon for Grêmio, which relies on the consistency of its takers to increase scoring opportunities. The presence of players like Jean Pyerre, who has already scored three times, reinforces the team's ability to capitalize on direct set-piece moments.

updated data

The most recent records of free-kick goals for Grêmio, Palmeiras, and Atlético-MG date back to September 16, 2026, July 29, 2026, and December 7, 2025, respectively.

With information from ge, Torcedores, Bnews.
